story_type: hoist camera looking down the cable at a giant container ship under way
hook: A camera looked straight down the cable at a 964-foot ship.
narration: This camera looked straight down the hoist cable at a 964-foot container ship.
The Zim Haifa was ninety-seven miles east of Cold Bay, Alaska.
A valve had dropped on one crewman's hand, and he needed a clinic.
A ship this big cannot stop quickly, so the helicopter matches her speed and sets the basket down as both keep moving.
The flight mechanic reached out for the cable as the basket came back up with him inside.
outcome: The Kodiak crew pulled the 48-year-old aboard and flew him to the Cold Bay clinic, where he was reported stable.

title: Hoist cam over a 964-foot cargo ship
description:
On July 12, 2010, a Coast Guard Air Station Kodiak HH-65 Dolphin crew hoisted an injured crewmember from the 964-foot container ship Zim Haifa, about 97 miles east of Cold Bay, Alaska.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Air Station Kodiak, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/315653
